description: General Corporate cash flow presentation skeleton with provisional candidate mappings from facts_by_statement.json. Direct and indirect methods are alternative presentations and must not be summed. Groups, nested components, gross/net amounts and continuing/discontinued operations details may overlap and do not imply arithmetic or concept equivalence. Review concepts require taxonomy and filing-context validation before use. Cash reconciliation must use a consistent cash scope, including the exchange-rate effect and whether net change includes it. Beginning and ending balances use the same metric with different instant contexts selected against the cash-flow duration. Operating asset/liability changes are duration adjustments, not BS balances. Source signs are preserved; cash-flow contribution signs require separate concept and filing validation. Analytical metrics have no calculation definition yet. Supplementary disclosures may overlap primary amounts. Coverage measures candidate placement only, not verified semantic coverage or complete CF coverage. Empty groups intentionally reserve baseline presentation slots absent from the filtered candidate set; they are not zero amounts and do not establish full concept coverage. Direct-method slots require evidence of a direct-method presentation; individual cash-payment disclosures alone do not establish that method. Period type and unit metadata remain unassigned pending concept-definition validation. IncreaseDecreaseIn concepts must not be assigned a universal sign inversion.

metadata_notes.period_and_unit: Period and unit types checked against the 2026 taxonomy. Historical filings require their own taxonomy context.
metadata_notes.contra: False identifies these flows, adjustments and disclosed balances as not intrinsic deduction balances; it does not prescribe fact signs or cash-flow direction.
metadata_notes.unmapped_placeholders: Original concept-free placeholders retained outside the skeleton tree; no mapped concepts were removed.
metadata_notes.review_reasons: Review reasons record checks still required against the filing; they do not resolve accounting classification.
